cues.zh: 氦气并不是一种可再生资源，至少在人类的时间尺度上不是。
cues.en: Helium is not a renewable resource, at least not on any human timescale.

cues.zh: 它虽然不是化石燃料，却是由地底深处的放射性衰变
cues.en: It's not a fossil fuel, but it is made very slowly by radioactive decay

cues.zh: 极其缓慢地生成的。
cues.en: deep down in the ground.

cues.zh: 所以从资源管理的角度来看，我们应该像对待化石燃料一样对待它。
cues.en: So in terms of managing it, we should be treating it like a fossil fuel.

cues.zh: 它一旦被开采出来、使用后逸散到大气中，
cues.en: Once it's pulled up from the ground, used, and dispersed into the atmosphere,

cues.zh: 想要回收的成本就会高得离谱。
cues.en: it is ludicrously expensive to recover.

cues.zh: 而且随着时间的推移，这些逸散的氦气因为足够轻、且极不活泼，
cues.en: And over time, that dispersed helium is light enough and unreactive enough that

cues.zh: 最终会以极其缓慢的速度逃逸到太空中，
cues.en: eventually, very, very slowly, it escapes off into space,

cues.zh: 这就成了个大问题，因为氦气的作用极其广泛。
cues.en: which is a problem because helium is enormously useful.

cues.zh: 我们将其广泛应用于各种科研与医疗领域，
cues.en: We use it in all sorts of science and medicine,

cues.zh: 比如给核磁共振（MRI）设备的磁体降温，用于工业制造，
cues.en: to keep the magnets in MRI machines cool, in manufacturing processes,

cues.zh: 当然，还有用来充气艇和派对气球。
cues.en: and, yes, to inflate blimps and party balloons.

cues.zh: 大约在过去十年里，
cues.en: And over the last decade or so,

cues.zh: 出现了很多耸人听闻的新闻文章
cues.en: there have been a lot of breathless news articles

cues.zh: 宣称世界上的氦气正在耗尽。
cues.en: proclaiming that the world is running out of helium.

cues.zh: 世界上大量的氦气来自美国大平原之下。
cues.en: A lot of the world's helium comes from under the Great Plains of the USA.

cues.zh: 在德克萨斯州阿马里洛这里，美国政府
cues.en: And here in Amarillo, Texas, the US government

cues.zh: 拥有国家氦气储备。
cues.en: has the National Helium Reserve.

cues.zh: 至少目前还是这样。
cues.en: At least, they do for now.

cues.zh: - 我们正站在布什穹顶之上，
cues.en: - We're standing on top of the Bush Dome,

cues.zh: 这个储层充当储存库，
cues.en: the reservoir that acts as the storage reservoir,

cues.zh: 它位于地下约3500英尺处。
cues.en: which is approximately 3,500 feet underground.

cues.zh: 就像海绵吸水并把水留在海绵里一样，
cues.en: As a sponge absorbs water and holds that water in the sponge,

cues.zh: 同样，岩石中的小孔隙就是氦气可以驻留的空间。
cues.en: similarly, the small pores in the rock are spaces where the helium can reside.

cues.zh: 肉眼看上去是坚硬的岩石，但它其实多孔，
cues.en: It's solid rock to the eye, but it is porous

cues.zh: 能让气体非常高效地储存在地下。
cues.en: and allows the gas to be stored very efficiently underground.

cues.zh: 这个储层原本是一个天然气储层。
cues.en: This reservoir was a natural gas reservoir.

cues.zh: 它曾经枯竭，后来在 20 世纪 60 年代重新注入
cues.en: It was depleted, then recharged in the sixties

cues.zh: 向地下注入了 320 亿立方英尺的氦气。
cues.en: with 32 billion cubic feet of helium into the ground.

cues.zh: 所以我们现在开采的，其实是之前注入的氦气
cues.en: So it's actually helium that we've injected previously

cues.zh: 我们现在正在提取的。
cues.en: that we're extracting now.

cues.zh: 整个计划的目标，是按照当时的消耗速度，将氦气保存约 100 年
cues.en: The whole program was to conserve the helium for about 100 years

cues.zh: 那么就要看消耗速率了。
cues.en: of the consumption rate then.

cues.zh: 当然，氦气已经成了非常受欢迎的元素，用途也很多，
cues.en: Of course, helium has become such a popular element, it has so many uses,

cues.zh: 所以现在的消耗速度远高于最初的估算。
cues.en: that now, that rate is quite a bit more than originally estimated.

cues.zh: 这些氦气是在大约 15 年间开采出来的。
cues.en: That helium has been withdrawn over approximately 15 years.

cues.zh: 我们现在的计划也快要结束了，
cues.en: And we are now reaching the end of our program

cues.zh: 因为气田的压力正在下降。
cues.en: as the field is declining in pressure.

cues.zh: 众所周知，氦气很容易从任何细小的开口逸出。
cues.en: Helium is notoriously known for being able to escape through any small opening.

cues.zh: 它被用作检漏气体。
cues.en: It's used as a leak detection substance.

cues.zh: 氦气很容易检测。
cues.en: You can detect helium very easily.

cues.zh: 如果它能跑出来，就说明这个设备或产品上有个地方漏了。
cues.en: And if it's able to get out, you have a hole somewhere in that device or product.

cues.zh: 把它重新埋回地下，它就不会从
cues.en: By putting it back in the ground, it's not leaking out

cues.zh: 不锈钢容器或大型卡车里泄漏出来，
cues.en: of a stainless steel container or a big truck,

cues.zh: 而且很容易监测和控制。
cues.en: it's easily monitored and controlled.

cues.zh: ——这座工厂现在正处于一年一度的检修周，
cues.en: - The plant here is in its annual week of maintenance right now,

cues.zh: 这也是我能靠得这么近的原因之一。
cues.en: which is one of the reasons I'm allowed to get quite this close.

cues.zh: 不过，还是有些部分我不能给你们看。
cues.en: There are still parts I'm not allowed to show you, though.

cues.zh: ——我身后的设备其实是一个提纯装置。
cues.en: - The equipment behind me is actually an enrichment unit.

cues.zh: 储存在地下的气体已经和气田开采的天然气混合在一起，
cues.en: All that gas that was stored in the ground has mixed and blended

cues.zh: 不再处于富集状态。
cues.en: with natural gas from the field, and it's no longer in an enriched state.

cues.zh: 所以，让气体通过这套设备后，我们就能把它的纯度提高到
cues.en: So by bringing it through the equipment, we take that gas back up to

cues.zh: 大约 80% 的氦气，杂质中约有 20% 是氮气。
cues.en: approximately 80% purity of helium, about 20% impurity of nitrogen.

cues.zh: 这就是我们生产出来、送入那条425英里管道的东西
cues.en: That's what we produce and send up our 425-mile pipeline

cues.zh: 输送到那些私营氦气厂，由它们提纯到100%。
cues.en: to the private helium plants that then take it to 100%.

cues.zh: 世界上确实有些地方氦气正在枯竭，没错。
cues.en: There are places in the world that are running out of helium, that's correct.

cues.zh: 但美国怀俄明州仍有大约80到100年用量的
cues.en: But there's still approximately 80 to 100 years' worth

cues.zh: 已知氦气储量。
cues.en: of known helium reserves in the United States, in Wyoming.

cues.zh: 所以说氦气正在耗尽，其实并不太准确。
cues.en: So to say that we're running out of helium is actually a little bit incorrect.

cues.zh: 可用的氦气还有很多，新的氦气来源也在不断被发现。
cues.en: There's still a lot of helium available and new helium sources being found.

cues.zh: 随着近期氦气价格上涨，
cues.en: With the recent increases in the helium price,

cues.zh: 这反倒促使业界去寻找更多氦气资源。
cues.en: that's actually stimulated industry to go look for more helium resources.

cues.zh: 而他们确实找到了更多。
cues.en: And they have found more.

cues.zh: 所以我们预计在未来几年，
cues.en: So we expect that in the next few years,

cues.zh: 更多氦气将进入市场。
cues.en: more of this helium will be brought to market.

cues.zh: 短缺将会缓解，至少短期内是这样。
cues.en: And the shortage will be alleviated, at least for a short period of time.

cues.zh: 在当前全球尺度下，某种资源“枯竭”
cues.en: - Running out of something on our current planetary scale

cues.zh: 并不意味着它会突然彻底消失。
cues.en: doesn't mean there suddenly won't be any at all.

cues.zh: 它只是意味着剩下的存量价格会一路飙升，
cues.en: It just means that the price of what's left will rise higher and higher and higher

cues.zh: 直到更少的供给遇上更低的需求，
cues.en: until the lower supply meets lower demand,

cues.zh: 这可能会让地下某些更难开采的氦气藏
cues.en: which might make some more difficult to reach reservoirs of helium

cues.zh: 变得有勘探价值。
cues.en: under the ground worth exploring.

cues.zh: 这就是资本主义。
cues.en: That's capitalism.

cues.zh: 正因所有这些不确定性，氦气的价格
cues.en: Because of all that uncertainty, the price of helium

cues.zh: 在过去几年里剧烈波动。
cues.en: has been fluctuating a lot over the last few years.

cues.zh: 研究人员常常很难筹集到足够的资金
cues.en: And researchers are often having trouble finding enough money

cues.zh: 来维持实验运转。
cues.en: to keep their experiments going.

cues.zh: 没错，这也是为什么给派对气球充气变得巨贵无比。
cues.en: And yes, it's why filling party balloons is getting really expensive.

cues.zh: - 我们目前正处于该项目的最后两年，
cues.en: - We are now in the final two years of our program

cues.zh: 并面临着私有化进程的最后阶段。
cues.en: and facing the last part of our privatization effort.

cues.zh: 到2021年，我们将退出氦气业务
cues.en: By the year 2021, we will be stepping out of the helium activity

cues.zh: 并将其转让给私营实体。
cues.en: and transferring it to private entities.

cues.zh: 令人意外的是，有人提出了这样一个问题：
cues.en: Surprisingly enough, the question comes up about whether or not

cues.zh: 我们是否应该继续使用派对气球。
cues.en: we should be using party balloons.

cues.zh: 我恰好是派对气球的忠实粉丝。
cues.en: I happen to be a real fan of party balloons.

cues.zh: 所以就我个人偏好而言，我仍然很高兴我们还有派对气球。
cues.en: So for my preference, I still am glad that we have party balloons.

cues.zh: 考虑到氦气目前的价格水平，
cues.en: With the price of helium where it is,

cues.zh: 现在有很多节约用氦的措施
cues.en: there's so much conservation going on now

cues.zh: 派对气球实际上只占市场中很小的一部分。
cues.en: that the party balloons are actually a very small part of the market.

cues.zh: 近年来我们看到，随着新的氦气来源
cues.en: We've seen now in recent years with the newer helium sources

cues.zh: 投入运营，以及大家在氦气节约方面的巨大努力
cues.en: coming online and this great effort towards helium conservation

cues.zh: 这确实产生了影响，让每个人都能获得更多的氦气。
cues.en: that that's really had an impact in making more helium available for everyone.

cues.zh: 所以我觉得派对气球有点被冤枉了。
cues.en: So I think the party balloons kind of got a bad rap.

cues.zh: 我确实想过在视频结尾用搞笑的声音做总结
cues.en: - I did think about ending this video by delivering my conclusion in a silly voice

cues.zh: 比如吸一口氦气球里的气，但说实话，我们确实需要节约氦气
cues.en: by breathing from a helium balloon, but honestly, we do need to conserve helium

cues.zh: 而且我觉得那样会树立一个坏榜样。
cues.en: and I figured that would set a bad example.

cues.zh: 所以这个嘛……
cues.en: So this...

cues.zh: ……里面装的只是普通空气。
cues.en: ...it's just regular air.

cues.zh: 还好它飞走了！要是没飞起来那就太尴尬了。
cues.en: I'm glad that flew away! That would've looked terrible if it hadn't worked.
